title: Judge Dredd
subtitle: Where to start: the essential collected editions, in reading order
credit: A beginner path through Mega-City One in the Essential Judge Dredd volumes, with the mega-epics in story order and the completist routes last. Dredd was created by John Wagner and Carlos Ezquerra for 2000 AD. Unofficial fan project.
